name: DocumentProperties
description: A collection of DocumentProperty objects. Each DocumentProperty object represents a built-in or custom property of a container document.
remarks: Use the Add method to create a new custom property and add it to the DocumentProperties collection. You cannot use the Add method to create a built-in document property. Use BuiltinDocumentProperties(index), where _index_ is the index number of the built-in document property, to return a single DocumentProperty object that represents a specific built-in document property. Use CustomDocumentProperties(index), where _index_ is the number of the custom document property, to return a DocumentProperty object that represents a specific custom document property.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the DocumentProperties object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a DocumentProperty object from the DocumentProperties collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the DocumentProperties collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the DocumentProperties object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the DocumentProperties object was created. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, LinkToContent As Boolean, [Type As Variant], [Value As Variant], [LinkSource As Variant], lcid As Long, ppIDocProp As DocumentProperty)
methods.description: Creates a new custom document property. You can add a new document property only to the custom DocumentProperties collection.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The string of the Name of the property.

parameters.name: LinkToContent
parameters.description: Specifies whether the LinkToContent property is linked to the contents of the container document. If this argument is True, the _LinkSource_ argument is required; if it's False, the _Value_ argument is required.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The data type of the Type property. Can be one of the following MsoDocProperties constants: msoPropertyTypeBoolean, msoPropertyTypeDate, msoPropertyTypeFloat, msoPropertyTypeNumber, or msoPropertyTypeString.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The data value of the Value property, if it's not linked to the contents of the container document. The value is converted to match the data type specified by the _Type_ argument, and if it can't be converted, an error occurs. If _LinkToContent_ is True, the argument is ignored, and the new document property is assigned a default value until the linked property values are updated by the container application (usually when the document is saved).

parameters.name: LinkSource
parameters.description: Ignored if _LinkToContent_ is False. The source of the LinkSource property. The container application determines what types of source linking you can use. For example, DDE links use the "Server|Document!Item" syntax.
